column1: # Hand labels for the 200 words drawn from the final list (scripts/audit-sample.sh sample). One judgement per word, by the author, made
# knowing which sample the word came from:
#   topical    an obvious sensitive reason (sex, violence, drugs, slurs, religion,
#   lookalike  no reason on its own, but spelled like a word that has one
# Disagree? Edit the label and rerun `nosuggest report` (scripts/build-site.sh).
